title: Contact Us - Get in Touch with ToolsBuilt Team
description: Get in touch with the ToolsBuilt team for feedback, feature requests, or technical support. Contact Abu Umair and the ToolsBuilt team directly.
subtitle: Have questions, tool suggestions, or bug reports? We would love to hear from you.

direct-email-contact.heading: Direct Email Contact
direct-email-contact.p1: You can reach our team directly by email at: abuumair2025@gmail.com

how-we-can-help.heading: How We Can Help
how-we-can-help.p1: We welcome all messages regarding ToolsBuilt, including:
how-we-can-help.li1: Tool Requests: Suggest a new calculator or converter you would like us to build.
how-we-can-help.li2: Bug Reports: Report any calculation discrepancies, UI issues, or browser display glitches.
how-we-can-help.li3: Feedback & Suggestions: Let us know how we can make our tools even easier to use.
how-we-can-help.li4: General Inquiries: Questions regarding site policies, partnership, or usage terms.

response-time.heading: Response Time
response-time.p1: We aim to review and respond to all user inquiries within 24 to 48 business hours. Thank you for using ToolsBuilt!
